title: CTB STADIUM V1.4
author: Adventurous_Bit_2408
selftext:
Pokemon Stadium fan version that uses a multi move managing CTB battle system.

[CTB Stadium v1.4](https://neerajneonemesis.github.io/CTB-Stadium/)

Added battle commentary that displays moves and effectiveness as it plays out. Added a comment toggle so the comments can be toggled.

u/kingnorik how does this fare? 

u/pianoboy777 does this now feel laggy?

replies.author: Adventurous_Bit_2408
replies.body:
It depends on what format you were playing. And it follows a snake draft where you pick 1 you ban 1, u pick 2 ban 2. The order differs on format, and the top box is saying it's your turn to ban a mon from the roster.
The order for doubles is 1-2-1-1-2-1 and 1-2-2-2-2-2-1 for singles, set so for balancing reasons. I think the confusion came from there. You think the draw order in it's entirety need to be displayed in game? Or should I add a drafting tutorial?

replies.author: pianoboy777
replies.body: Lolol yes lol I didn't know I had to ban another one lol I'll try again

comments.body: Alright all is fixed lol you seem to have made it faster too lol i got my ass beat still but that's my problem. This is the last complaint. I had fun even losing lol

replies.author: Adventurous_Bit_2408
replies.body: Try campaign. It has an easier learning curve as it utilises a dynamic ai aggression system. It's designed to be easier to start and gets stronger as you progress.
